## Context
Cut the next minor release, 0.12.0, from reviewed main using docs/releasing.md. Prior package/tag: 0.11.0/v0.11.0. PyPI is immutable; publication uses the dispatch-from-main workflow and its pypi environment approval. Release date 2026-08-15. Closed ticket reflective-sticky-grouper (9874-b1a9-2ff1-4cd3) is the 0.11.0 precedent, not duplicate work. CHANGELOG's [Unreleased] already holds curated entries, so step 1a is a retitle to [0.12.0] - 2026-08-15 (fresh [Unreleased], compare links updated), not a regeneration.

## Plan
- Fresh worktree from origin/main; confirm prerequisites, identity, Gerrit rights, channel state.
- Bump pyproject.toml + every server.json version to 0.12.0; regenerate uv.lock; retitle CHANGELOG's curated [Unreleased] to [0.12.0] - 2026-08-15 with fresh [Unreleased] and compare links.
- Preflight: version-lockstep guard, release tests, lint, typecheck, full tests, build, twine.
- Commit with DCO + Change-Id + rebar-ticket trailer; Gerrit review to LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with no unresolved comments; Submit.
- Dispatch release.yml from main with version=0.12.0; obtain the pypi environment approval; monitor to a terminal result.
- Verify PyPI + PEP 740 provenance, GitHub tag/release + artifacts, MCP Registry, Homebrew tap bump (trigger autobump).
- Channel-install nava-rebar[mcp]==0.12.0 and run the packaged post-publication probe.
- Record receipts on this ticket; close only after all acceptance criteria are met.

## File impact
- pyproject.toml — package version bump
- server.json — MCP manifest/package version bump
- uv.lock — root package version lockstep with pyproject.toml
- CHANGELOG.md — retitled curated 0.12.0 release section and compare links

## Rollback / failure policy
Before publish: stop on any failed guard/review/CI vote; remediate via a new Gerrit patchset. After publish PyPI cannot be replaced: yank 0.12.0, de-list its GitHub Release, cut a fixed patch version; never overwrite artifacts or retag published content.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] pyproject.toml declares version 0.12.0.
- [x] server.json top-level version is 0.12.0.
- [x] Every server.json packages[].version is 0.12.0.
- [x] [operator-attested] uv.lock records the root nava-rebar package at version 0.12.0 and `uv lock --check` exits 0.
  provenance: environment=worktree venv; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — uv lock && uv lock --check exit 0; nava-rebar block reads 0.12.0.
- [x] CHANGELOG.md contains a hand-curated 0.12.0 section dated 2026-08-15.
- [x] CHANGELOG.md has a fresh Unreleased section and correct 0.12.0 compare links.
- [x] `python scripts/release_guards.py version-lockstep --version 0.12.0 --pyproject pyproject.toml --server-json server.json` exits 0.
- [x] [operator-attested] Release-specific guard and workflow tests exit 0.
  provenance: environment=worktree venv; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — 40 passed.
- [x] [operator-attested] `make lint` exits 0 under the worktree virtualenv.
  provenance: environment=worktree venv; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — exit 0.
- [x] [operator-attested] `make typecheck` exits 0 under the worktree virtualenv.
  provenance: environment=worktree venv; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — no issues, 551 files.
- [x] [operator-attested] `make test` exits 0 under the worktree virtualenv.
  provenance: environment=worktree venv, harness GIT_CONFIG_* injection removed; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — 13525 passed, 0 failed (injection root-caused as environmental; see comment).
- [x] [operator-attested] `python -m build` produces the 0.12.0 wheel and sdist.
  provenance: environment=worktree venv; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — wheel+sdist built.
- [x] [operator-attested] `python -m twine check dist/*` exits 0 for the built artifacts.
  provenance: environment=uvx twine; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — both artifacts PASSED.
- [x] [operator-attested] The release commit contains DCO sign-off, a Gerrit Change-Id, and this rebar-ticket trailer.
  provenance: environment=worktree; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — git log -1: Signed-off-by, Change-Id I4603345a…, rebar-ticket trailer present (landed b0aac2314b).
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit records LLM-Review +1 on the release change.
  provenance: environment=Gerrit REST change 1825; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — LLM-Review +1 by rebar review bot.
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit records Verified +1 on the release change.
  provenance: environment=Gerrit REST change 1825; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Verified +1 by rebar CI bot.
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit has no unresolved comments on the release change.
  provenance: environment=Gerrit REST change 1825; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — unresolved_comment_count=0.
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit submits the release change and the resulting commit is on main.
  provenance: environment=Gerrit REST change 1825 submit; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — MERGED; origin/main = b0aac2314b.
- [x] [operator-attested] release.yml is dispatched from main with version input 0.12.0.
  provenance: environment=gh CLI; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — run 31916566035, ref main, headSha b0aac2314b, version=0.12.0.
- [x] [operator-attested] The required pypi environment deployment is approved.
  provenance: environment=GitHub REST pending_deployments; principal=JoeOakhartNava (configured required reviewer); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — approved; publish proceeded.
- [x] [operator-attested] Every required release.yml job completes successfully.
  provenance: environment=gh run 31916566035; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — 10/10 success.
- [x] PyPI serves nava-rebar 0.12.0.
- [x] `uvx pypi-attestations verify pypi` on the published 0.12.0 wheel with --repository https://github.com/navapbc/rebar exits 0.
- [x] GitHub tag v0.12.0 resolves to the released main commit.
- [x] [operator-attested] GitHub Release v0.12.0 is marked Latest.
  provenance: environment=GitHub REST releases/latest; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — tag_name=v0.12.0.
- [x] [operator-attested] GitHub Release v0.12.0 attaches the 0.12.0 wheel and sdist.
  provenance: environment=GitHub REST releases/latest; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — wheel, sdist, SHA256SUMS attached.
- [x] MCP Registry reports io.github.navapbc/rebar version 0.12.0.
- [x] [operator-attested] Homebrew tap Formula/rebar.rb points to the 0.12.0 PyPI sdist URL.
  provenance: environment=tap Formula/rebar.rb post-autobump 31917337582; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — url = 0.12.0 sdist.
- [x] [operator-attested] Homebrew tap Formula/rebar.rb SHA-256 equals the PyPI 0.12.0 sdist digest.
  provenance: environment=formula vs PyPI JSON; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — digests equal (61a62efa…).
- [x] A fresh channel install of nava-rebar[mcp]==0.12.0 passes scripts/probe_rebar.py with zero failures.
- [x] Release receipts, any exceptions, and the rollback disposition are recorded on this ticket.
